content_2.en:
Serving others is one of the most fulfilling and life-changing experiences you can volunteer for.

Vivid Faith exists to provide you with opportunities to help others in the context of mission. You can help in various areas, such as: evangelism, medicine and health, education, and administration, amongst others.

In partnership with Adventist Volunteer Service, we offer service opportunities around the world.

If you are between 18 and 35 years old, AYS also offers you financial support and guidance for each service opportunity.
